notablePrerequisites:
Wight of the Reliquary does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additional creature.
description:
Activate Wight of the Reliquary by tapping it and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, If the creature was a Dragon Egg, the creature triggers, creating a 2/2 Dragon creature token.
Resolve the Wight of the Reliquary ability, causing you to search your library for a land card and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield, Nesting Dragon triggers, creating a 0/2 Dragon Egg creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.
